description.text:
The Japanese deck handed to Japan's players at the 2001 International Tropical Mega Battle, held for players aged 14 and under at the Hilton Hawaiian Village in Honolulu on 25 and 26 August 2001. For its VS Shield Battle every player got the same 30-card deck, in their own language or in English, the Leaders' Pokémon half deck sold in Japan that July with its Rocket's Tyranitar and Darkness Energy swapped for a new promo, Tropical Breeze (Tropical Wind in Japanese), numbered 008/P. Apart from that card, the Japanese players' cards are the same as the shop deck's.

Japan's places went to the junior winners of the Neo Summer Road tournaments and to lottery winners from their side events, and the decks came in the orange deck boxes of the 2001 Neo Spring and Summer Road tournaments, with a VS coin from the same events.
